description.en: Instance catalog for Civolution. Stores detailed data for effects, module tiles, cards, continent tiles, sites, chips, and other concrete instances.

definition.en: Physical tile for the Migration module. Flipped for L1→L2, removed for L2→L3.
Physical tile for the Procreation module.
Physical tile for the Production module.

description.zh: 支付 1 个点数 1 的<activation_die>。
description.en: Pay 1 <activation_die> showing value 1.

description.zh: 支付 1 个点数 3 的<activation_die>。
description.en: Pay 1 <activation_die> showing value 3.

description.zh: 同时支付 1 个点数 1 的<activation_die>和 1 个点数 3 的<activation_die>（两项都要支付，不是二选一）。
description.en: Pay BOTH 1 <activation_die> showing value 1 AND 1 showing value 3 (both required, not either-or).

description.zh: 执行 1 次迁徙。
description.en: Perform 1 migration.

description.zh: 先过 1 次恩惠检定：通过则最多迁徙 2 次，未通过则迁徙 1 次。
description.en: Take a favor test first: if it passes, perform up to 2 migrations; if not, perform 1 migration.

description.zh: 先过 1 次恩惠检定：通过则最多迁徙 3 次，未通过则最多迁徙 2 次。同一部落多次迁徙时，仅最终落定的领地生效，其余领地只是穿越（不进入营地、不获得火营地分、不开发领地）。
description.en: Take a favor test first: if it passes, perform up to 3 migrations; if not, up to 2 migrations. When the same tribe migrates multiple times, only the final territory is settled; the others are merely crossed through (no encampment entry, no fire encampment points, no territory development).

description.zh: 支付 1 个点数 2 的<activation_die>。
description.en: Pay 1 <activation_die> showing value 2.

description.zh: 支付 1 个点数 5 的<activation_die>。
description.en: Pay 1 <activation_die> showing value 5.

description.zh: 同时支付 1 个点数 2 的<activation_die>和 1 个点数 5 的<activation_die>（两项都要支付，不是二选一）。
description.en: Pay BOTH 1 <activation_die> showing value 2 AND 1 showing value 5 (both required, not either-or).

description.zh: 执行 1 次繁育。
description.en: Perform 1 procreation.

description.zh: 先过 1 次恩惠检定：通过则最多繁育 2 次，未通过则繁育 1 次。
description.en: Take a favor test first: if it passes, perform up to 2 procreations; if not, perform 1 procreation.

description.zh: 最多繁育 2 次（可同区域或不同区域），随后过 1 次恩惠检定：通过则可强化 1 个虚弱部落（可不做）。两步骤顺序可互换。
description.en: Perform up to 2 procreations (same or different territories), then take a favor test: if it passes, you may strengthen 1 weak tribe. The two steps may be performed in either order.

description.zh: 支付 1 个点数 3 的<activation_die>。
description.en: Pay 1 <activation_die> showing value 3.

description.zh: 支付 1 个点数 5 的<activation_die>。
description.en: Pay 1 <activation_die> showing value 5.

description.zh: 同时支付 1 个点数 3 的<activation_die>和 1 个点数 5 的<activation_die>（两项都要支付，不是二选一）。
description.en: Pay BOTH 1 <activation_die> showing value 3 AND 1 showing value 5 (both required, not either-or).

description.zh: 生产 2 个原材料（可在相同或不同区域），随后过 1 次恩惠检定：通过则可运输 1 次原材料（可不做）。两步骤顺序可互换。
description.en: Produce 2 raw materials (in the same or different territories), then take a favor test: if it passes, you may transport 1 raw material. The two steps may be performed in either order.

description.zh: 共生产 3 个原材料（可在 1、2 或 3 个区域），并运输 1 个大陆上任意位置的原材料到仓库。两步骤顺序可互换。
description.en: Produce a total of 3 raw materials (in one, two, or three territories), and transport 1 raw material from anywhere on the continent to your storage. The two steps may be performed in either order.

description.zh: 共生产 4 个原材料（可在 1~4 个区域），并运输任意 2 个原材料到仓库。两步骤顺序可互换。
description.en: Produce a total of 4 raw materials (in one to four territories), and transport any 2 raw materials from the continent to your storage. The two steps may be performed in either order.

description.zh: 支付 1 个点数 1 的<activation_die>。
description.en: Pay 1 <activation_die> showing value 1.

description.zh: 支付 1 个点数 5 的<activation_die>。

description.en: Pay BOTH 1 <activation_die> showing value 1 AND 1 showing value 5 (both required, not either-or).

description.zh: 运输 3 个大陆上任意位置的原材料到仓库。
description.en: Transport 3 of your raw materials from anywhere on the continent to your storage.

description.zh: 运输 6 个原材料到仓库。
description.en: Transport 6 of your raw materials to your storage.

description.zh: 运输大陆上所有原材料到仓库：陆地原材料按所在区域类型入格；船载原材料可放到任意仓库格（不限于相邻已开发区域类型）。
description.en: Transport all of your raw materials from the continent to your storage: land materials go to their territory-type spaces; boat materials may go to any storage space (not limited to adjacent developed territory types).

description.zh: 支付 1 个点数 2 的<activation_die>。

description.en: Pay BOTH 1 <activation_die> showing value 2 AND 1 showing value 4 (both required, not either-or).

description.zh: 进行 1 次狩猎；或强化 1 个虚弱部落。
description.en: Perform a hunt; or strengthen 1 of your weak tribes.

description.zh: 进行 1 次狩猎；或强化最多 3 个虚弱部落。
description.en: Perform a hunt; or strengthen up to 3 of your weak tribes.

description.zh: 连续进行最多 2 次狩猎（须在不同区域）；或强化最多 4 个虚弱部落。
description.en: Perform up to 2 consecutive hunts (in different territories); or strengthen up to 4 of your weak tribes.

description.zh: 支付 1 个点数 1 的<activation_die>。

description.zh: 选择 1 个有你部落的区域，探索其相邻的所有背面朝上地点；或进行 1 次幸运收获。
description.en: Choose a territory with at least one of your tribes and explore all face-down sites adjacent to it; or make 1 lucky find.

description.zh: 先探索选定的有部落区域相邻的所有背面朝上地点，随后可任选大陆上 1 枚背面朝上地点进行探索（可不做），最后获得 2 分；或进行 1 次幸运收获。
description.en: Explore all face-down sites adjacent to a territory with your tribe, then optionally explore 1 more face-down site anywhere on the continent, and finally gain 2 success points; or make 1 lucky find.

description.zh: 不做（跳过此项）
description.en: Skip this option

description.zh: 先探索选定的有部落区域相邻的所有背面朝上地点，随后可任选大陆上 1 枚背面朝上地点进行探索（可不做），最后额外获得 4 分；或连续进行 2 次幸运收获（可在相同或不同的领地类型）。
description.en: Explore all face-down sites adjacent to a territory with your tribe, then optionally explore 1 more face-down site anywhere on the continent, and finally gain 4 additional success points; or make 2 consecutive lucky finds (in the same or in different territory types).

description.zh: 不做（跳过此项）
description.en: Skip this option

description.zh: 完成 1 个建造项目（农场/船/雕像/聚落）；或从手牌安装 1 张建造牌。
description.en: Complete 1 building project (farm/boat/statue/settlement); or install 1 building card from your hand.

description.zh: 完成最多 2 个同类型建造项目；或从手牌安装 1 张建造牌。
description.en: Complete up to 2 building projects of the same type; or install 1 building card from your hand.

description.zh: 完成最多 2 个建造项目（可同类型或不同类型）；或从手牌安装 1 张建造牌并选择特殊奖励：忽略 1 个非唯一费用格，或安装后再立即安装 1 张同类型建造牌。
description.en: Complete up to 2 building projects (same or different types); or install 1 building card from your hand with a special bonus: ignore 1 non-unique active cost space, or immediately install another building card after.

name.zh: 安装建造牌（含特殊奖励）

description.zh: 安装时可将任意 1 个非唯一的费用格视为空（该费用格失效；若费用格是唯一一个激活的费用格则不能忽略）。
description.en: When installing, any 1 non-unique active cost space may be treated as empty/inactive (not allowed if it would leave no active cost spaces).

name.en: Install Another Card of Same Type

description.zh: 若未忽略费用格，安装后可立即按通常规则从手牌再安装 1 张同类型研究牌。
description.en: If no cost space was ignored, immediately install another research card of the same type from hand per the usual rules.

description.en: Install 1 goal chip; or take 2 markers as planning markers onto the same dice space.

description.zh: 安装 1 枚目标芯片；或放置 3 个计划标记到同一骰子格。
description.en: Install 1 goal chip; or place 3 markers as planning markers onto the same dice space.

description.zh: 获得 1 枚目标芯片（展示区取入目标区）并/或安装 1 枚目标芯片（顺序自定）；或放置 3 个计划标记到同一骰子格。
description.en: Gain 1 goal chip (from the display into your goal area) and/or install 1 goal chip, in either order; or place 3 markers as planning markers onto the same dice space.

description.en: Gain either 1 activation die or 1 fate die; or install 1 achievement card from your hand.

description.zh: 获得 1 个激活骰和 1 个命运骰；或从手牌安装 1 张成就牌。
description.en: Gain 1 activation die and 1 fate die; or install 1 achievement card from your hand.

description.zh: 获得 1 个激活骰和 1 个命运骰；或从手牌安装 1 张成就牌并选择特殊奖励（忽略 1 个非唯一费用格，或再安装 1 张同类型牌）。
description.en: Gain 1 activation die and 1 fate die; or install 1 achievement card from your hand with the special bonus (ignore 1 non-unique cost space, or install another card of the same type).

description.en: Do this up to twice: move 1 feature marker to any feature space; or install 1 mutation card from your hand.

description.zh: 执行最多 2 枚收入芯片的行动（可为 2 枚不同芯片或同一芯片 2 次）；或从手牌安装 1 张发明牌。

description.zh: 执行出售和购买行动各最多 2 次（顺序任意，可自由穿插）。
description.en: Perform the Sale action and the Purchase action up to twice each (in any order).

description.zh: 先获得 2 个钱币，再执行出售和购买行动各最多 2 次（顺序任意）。
description.en: Gain 2 money markers, then perform the Sale action and the Purchase action up to twice each (in any order).

description.zh: 支付 1 个点数 3 的<activation_die>。
description.en: Pay 1 <activation_die> showing value 3.

description.zh: 同时支付 1 个点数 2 的<activation_die>和 1 个点数 3 的<activation_die>（两项都要支付，不是二选一）。
description.en: Pay BOTH 1 <activation_die> showing value 2 AND 1 showing value 3 (both required, not either-or).

description.zh: 执行 1 个活动。
description.en: Perform 1 activity.

description.zh: 执行 1~2 个活动，第二次执行的活动必须与第一次不同（不可重复执行同一活动）。
description.en: Perform 1 or 2 activities; the second activity must differ from the first (the same activity may not be performed twice).

<ontology::condition>.zh: 第二次选择的活动与第一次不同（同一活动在一次激活中不可重复执行）。
<ontology::condition>.en: The activity chosen the second time must differ from the first (the same activity may not be performed twice in one activation).

description.zh: 执行最多 2 个活动，可以是两个不同的活动，也可以是同一个活动执行两次。
description.en: Perform up to 2 activities; they may be two different activities or the same activity twice.

description.zh: 支付 2 个点数均为 1 的<activation_die>。
description.en: Pay 2 <activation_die>s both showing value 1.

description.zh: 获得 1 个耐力<feature_marker>。
description.en: Gain 1 Stamina <feature_marker>.

description.zh: 支付 2 个点数均为 2 的<activation_die>。
description.en: Pay 2 <activation_die>s both showing value 2.

description.zh: 获得 1 个智慧<feature_marker>。
description.en: Gain 1 Intelligence <feature_marker>.

description.zh: 支付 2 个点数均为 3 的<activation_die>。
description.en: Pay 2 <activation_die>s both showing value 3.

description.zh: 获得 1 个镇定<feature_marker>。
description.en: Gain 1 Calm <feature_marker>.

description.zh: 支付 2 个点数均为 4 的<activation_die>。
description.en: Pay 2 <activation_die>s both showing value 4.

description.zh: 获得 1 个灵巧<feature_marker>。
description.en: Gain 1 Dexterity <feature_marker>.

description.zh: 支付 2 个点数均为 5 的<activation_die>。
description.en: Pay 2 <activation_die>s both showing value 5.

description.zh: 获得 1 个表达<feature_marker>。
description.en: Gain 1 Expression <feature_marker>.

description.zh: 支付 2 个点数均为 6 的<activation_die>。
description.en: Pay 2 <activation_die>s both showing value 6.

description.zh: 获得 1 个观察<feature_marker>。
description.en: Gain 1 Perception <feature_marker>.

description.zh: 支付任意 2 个<activation_die>，点数不限。
description.en: Pay any 2 <activation_die>s, any values.

description.zh: 健康状态。部落可以迁徙和繁育。
description.en: Healthy state. Tribe can migrate and procreate.

description.zh: 虚弱状态。部落不能迁徙，喂养阶段若未被喂饱会死亡。
description.en: Weakened state. Tribe cannot migrate; dies in Feeding phase if not fed.

definition.zh: <console> 右上角自带的基础活动。支付 1 个 <money>，从 5 条进程轨中任选 1 条，将该轨上自己的 <progress_marker> 推进 1 格。
definition.en: Innate activity at the top-right of the <console>. Pay 1 <money>, choose any 1 of the 5 progress tracks, and advance your <progress_marker> on that track by 1 step.
